summary: Frontend-only testing of multiple bug fixes: 1) Somatic page loads with 39 practices without login, 2) All public content pages accessible without auth (/shamanic, /elemental, /oracle, /creative, /heart-practices), 3) Meditations TTS shows 'Guided audio ready' status, 4) Email/password registration creates account and redirects to dashboard, 5) TopNav appears on content pages with Home button, 6) Back navigation works correctly (doesn't go to sign-in)

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent - minor accessibility issue

critical_code_review_comments: All public routes correctly use PublicRoute component - pages load without login
TTS integration working - 'Guided audio ready' status displays after clicking meditation
Email/password registration flow working - redirects to /dashboard after account creation
TopNav component shows Home button, current page dropdown, and Sign In/Dashboard link
Back button navigates to /dashboard for logged-in users, or landing page for non-logged-in users (expected behavior)
Browser back button works correctly - navigates through history without auth issues
Minor: 401 errors in console for /auth/me and /favorites endpoints are expected for non-logged-in users (silently handled)
